master.prompt:
Create a single complete loaded game vehicle Dune Jackal, dune-jackal-18. Brief: 

- Vehicle: burnt orange 4×4 pickup scout with an open bed
- Load (drawn as part of the vehicle): a folded white satellite dish on a cradle
- Equipment: rear spare carrier and ladder
- Finish: mud-caked lower panels
- Tires: 1.49 m spiked tires: off-road mud-terrain tires studded with rows of short steel spikes

. Exactly TWO near-side road wheels (two axles). Vehicle empty mass 5.1 tonnes; whole vehicle length about 6.2 metres. Its load is integrated securely using straps, chains, cradles or side rails. Draw the full coupled tractor AND trailer as ONE image when present, not separate parts. Keep all near-side tires unobstructed by steps. For banners or flags use blank bold colours, no lettering. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Facing RIGHT, cab front face invisible. Exactly circular near tires, centred rims, level hub centres and tire bottoms. Horizontal chassis and deck, no yaw, no tilt. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration in approved Swamp Scout style: dark readable contours, weathered materials, fine mechanical detail, rich natural texture. Soft even daylight. True transparent background, no ground, cast shadow, glow, lettering, logos or watermark. Entire object has generous clear margins on all four sides, occupies only central 85% of canvas width and 80% of height. Wide PNG at least 1500 pixels across.
